content.title: How DirecTV’s free trial lets you watch March Madness games free today and all weekend
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation. By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.com March Madness begins with round 1 action today, as games start this morning . Each matchup will be televised on one of these networks: TNT, TBS, TruTV, and CBS. The first game will tip off at 11:15 a.m. CT, while the final game of the day begins at 9:10 p.m. CT. Fans can watch each NCAA Tournament game for free online by using the free trial offered by DirecTV . Alternatively, Sling offers a day pass and Entertainment Extra bundle for just $5.99. Basketball fans can gain access to all four channels needed to watch March Madness by utilizing DirecTV . It currently offers a five-day free trial , which would let fans see the first and second round games this week. Why is DirecTV a Great Streaming Option for March Madness? The DirecTV five-day free trial is a great deal, as the first and second round games will transpire over the next four days. DirecTV consumers also have immediate access to every channel needed to watch March Madness, which other streaming services cannot provide. All four channels are accessible with these DirecTV streaming packages: Choice , Ultimate , and Premier .
